actual: PR #1993 moved Advisory Phase 0A2C prospective evidence validation into the shared inference/selection path. Multi-alpha lineage aggregation currently treats per-leg historical input window identities as cross-leg invariants, so valid LSTM and fundamental legs with different lookback/window provenance fail before Selection Center, Paper v2, Simulation Runtime, or Advisory consumption. Preserve strict common PIT date/calendar/universe/source validation while allowing each leg to retain its own valid lookback/window lineage. Add regression coverage for shared selection consumers and fail closed on true common-PIT mismatches.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
